title: Find Your Angle
summary: More tilt means more speed. Lean in, then pull back to stop on the far pad.

lines.text: The further you tilt, the faster you go. A small lean is a slow cruise.
To slow down, tip the nose back up past level for a moment. Then let it settle.

practice.instruction: Fly through both gates, then slow down and land on the pad at the end of the lane.
